project_type: Laravel 11 backend — leave management system for Egyptian schools
build_system: Composer; no compile step needed. Config cache: `php artisan config:clear`
test_framework: Pest 3.x with pest-plugin-laravel. RefreshDatabase is applied to ALL Feature and Unit tests via Pest.php uses() call.
verification_instructions: Run `./vendor/bin/pest --no-coverage` from /Users/mohamedgaber/projects/vaccancy/leave-management-system. Tests use in-memory SQLite (DB_DATABASE=:memory: in phpunit.xml). The helper function `createHierarchy()` is available globally in tests/Pest.php — use it to bootstrap org structure in tests.
environment_constraints: PHP 8.5 deprecation warning about PDO::MYSQL_ATTR_SSL_CA appears in test output — this is noise from vendor code; tests are marked as 'deprecated' not 'failed'. Exit code 0 = tests passed. The one known pre-existing failure is 'Employee entitlement grade → null grade defaults to 28' in Phase1FoundationTest — do not fix, do not count against Phase 2.
contribution_requirements: All balance mutations MUST go through LeaveBalanceService. All status changes MUST be wrapped in DB::transaction(). LeaveBalanceTransaction is append-only (no updates/deletes). WorkflowConfiguration drives step creation — read active steps ordered by step_order.
key_patterns: Models use $casts with enum classes. Observer pattern used for lifecycle hooks (observer stamps submitted_at via LeaveRequestObserver). Global scope OrganizationScope filters by authenticated user's org. Spatie Permission with teams (organization_id). Arabic labels in all enums. `remaining` on LeaveBalance is a computed accessor (entitled + carried_over - used), never stored. LeaveBalanceTransaction has `$timestamps = false`; `created_at` is set manually in booted(). Factories use state methods (e.g. ->submitted(), ->inReview()) for status variants.
relevant_files: app/Models/LeaveBalance.php (READ — fields: entitled, carried_over, used; computed remaining)
app/Models/LeaveRequestStep.php (READ — fields: step_order, stage, status, acted_by, acted_at, note)
app/Models/WorkflowConfiguration.php (READ — step_order, stage_name, approval_rule, required_role, is_active)
app/Observers/LeaveBalanceObserver.php (READ — warning guard to understand what the observer does)
directory_structure: app/Enums/ — 6 enums; app/Models/ — 11 models; app/Observers/ — 3 observers; app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php — observer registration + strict mode; database/migrations/ — 13 migration files; database/factories/ — 10 factories; database/seeders/ — 4 seeders; tests/Feature/ — Phase1FoundationTest.php; tests/Unit/ — EnumsTest.php; tests/Pest.php — global uses() + createHierarchy() helper
